mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility has improved in three of the last four weeks (-74.3 to -66.9), and each sustained transit recovery restores non-essential trip-making into Manhattan commercial districts, lifting RETAIL_REC over the following four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -74.3 to -66.9 over the four weekly means
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days while TRANSIT continues to improve, which would reject the transit-led footfall mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS has crossed from -43.7 to -29.6, and once outdoor activity exceeds the -35 line for two consecutive weeks, warm-weather leisure trips are routed through commercial corridors on the way to and from parks, raising RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean rises above -35 percent change and holds for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -43.7 to -29.6 across the last four weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines or stays flat over the two weeks after PARKS holds above -35, rejecting the claim that outdoor leisure traffic spills into retail and recreation.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL is decaying (23.3 to 19.4) while GROCERY_PHARM recovers (-39.1 to -32.0); the joint pattern means households are resuming local errand circuits, and errand trips anchor to retail strips, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from 23.3 to 19.4 while GROCERY_PHARM rose from -39.1 to -32.0
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL falls and GROCERY_PHARM rises simultaneously, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not higher than its level at the time the pattern is observed.

mechanism_narrative: Phased return-to-office orders raise WORKPLACES above -55 percent change, which repopulates Manhattan office districts and generates lunchtime and after-work retail demand, producing higher RETAIL_REC across the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES weekly mean rises above -55 percent change
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose from -64.0 to -54.1 over the last four weekly means
regime_hint: phased reopening with formal office-return mandates
failure_condition: WORKPLACES crosses above -55 and RETAIL_REC over the following 28 days is not above its prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS exceeds -30 percent change, outdoor recreation absorbs the discretionary time budget that would otherwise be spent indoors, substituting away from stores; RETAIL_REC therefore sags within one week of the crossing.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean exceeds -30 percent change
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS reached -29.6 in the most recent weekly mean
failure_condition: In the week after PARKS exceeds -30, RETAIL_REC is higher than or equal to its value in the crossing week, rejecting the substitution mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improving in the same week indicates a genuine commuting revival rather than isolated trips; the joint signal multiplies retail exposure in commercial districts and pushes RETAIL_REC up within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves by more than 3 points week-on-week while WORKPLACES also improves week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 3.0 points and WORKPLACES improved 3.0 points in the latest week
failure_condition: Weeks where TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve are followed by RETAIL_REC levels no higher than weeks where neither improves.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has recovered 7.1 points from its trough in the snapshot, and restored routine shopping trips generalize into neighboring discretionary retailers, so RETAIL_REC climbs over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM moved from -39.1 to -32.0 across the four weekly means
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM continues to recover but RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is at or below its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL remains elevated above +15 percent change, meaning a large share of households still conducts most daily life at home; with PARKS also high, discretionary trips stay suppressed, so RETAIL_REC's next four-week mean stays below its last four-week mean.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean remains above +15 percent change
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is 19.4 and PARKS is -29.6 in the latest week
failure_condition: While RESIDENTIAL stays above +15, RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean exceeds its last-28-day mean, rejecting the confinement-drag mechanism.
